Preview of the first release. Everything here is one batch of initial research, and every score is provisional until 2026-09-29. Organizations and people named here, and anyone else, can submit corrections or evidence until then; what arrives becomes the launch round of the paper. No tag is citable until the gates pass. How to submit. Update, 15 September: the re-derivation pass did not move values; earlier v0.1 rules and scope decisions did.

Status

What the record holds, how much of it has been re-derived, what counts under each evidence policy, who has been contacted, and what stands between this preview and a citable tag. Built 2026-09-15; event-log digest 5f547fcbc1c5; RULES.md v0.1 (2026-09-15). Every statistic on this page covers the 24 ranked organizations; the 1 watchlist entry and the 2 retained out-of-scope entries contribute to none.

Evidence standard

Imported rows are leads copied from another project's ledger and satisfy no gate. A 4 on funding requires a confirmed bounded negative in a filing or index. A 0 needs a quoted span; a 4 needs a span and a second source. Scores are readings of the public record at the build date, not endorsements.

What counts under each evidence policy

Evidence policyRuleRanked signals that countAssessments unevidenced
Leads includedEvery signal that is not quarantined counts, including imported and unverifiable leads, which can support only a 2. For research, not for citation.329 of 3301 of 192
Standard (default)A signal counts only if at least one cited source was re-fetched and confirmed. The default: no number moves on a source you cannot open and check.315 of 3306 of 192
Against interestStandard, and an organization's own statements count only when they are against its interest or backed by a non-self source.236 of 33048 of 192
Verified spansStandard, and the signal carries a quoted span you can find on the page.279 of 33025 of 192
Primary onlyOnly confirmed filings, funder indexes, or third-party ledgers with a quoted span: what can be verified from outside the field.37 of 330167 of 192

Second coder

15 assessment(s) second-coded; 15 agree with the stored value. A human second coder on every extreme (every stored 0 or 4) is a gate for a citable tag; the full population follows by v0.2. Disagreements are logged in data/coding/second-coder.csv and in the assessment's resolution.

Open questions

Kept in paper/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md with status, routes tried, and the document that would close each. Audits in paper/audits/. Replies from named organizations and people are filed as signals; after first publication, a score that moves by more than one anchor triggers a record packet (bench outreach).

Data

bench.json (evaluators, assessments with per-policy derivations, signals, sources), exposure.json, timeline.json, ledger CSVs, event log, RULES.md. Code Apache-2.0; data CC BY 4.0. Disclosure: DISCLOSURE.md.
